description: Transvaalbuurt 1920-1922 low rows with a recessed loggia (Colensostraat 13-28, Vaalrivierstraat 15-19): 5.7-6.1 m dark red-brown brick fronts of two storeys (upstairs and downstairs flats) under a steep red-tile roof with roof lights and a cream eaves board; on the upper storey a cream-framed window and, against one party wall, half of a loggia shared with the mirrored neighbour: a recess about 1 m deep over a solid brick parapet (pierced with small cross-shaped holes), glazed doors and windows at its back; under it the pair of front doors (green or blue, with top lights) beside the neighbour's under one flat canopy

match.note: Colensostraat 13-25 and 14-28 (BAG 1922) and Vaalrivierstraat 15-19 (BAG 1920; 21 is a 1986 rebuild, vetoed on year) on the 2019-12-19 and 2020-04-29 strips. As transvaal-1920-three-storey (same eaves, roof and wall; no eaves criterion: the 3DBAG front eaves read 4.9-5.9 m, the strips the cream eaves board at 6.2-6.6 m): the loggia and the door pair under one canopy tell this front from the canted-bay rows, which the facts cannot, so the faces are pinned to this type in transvaalbuurt-{oost,west}-review-types.json. Transvaalstraat 131-143 (1922) is a third design (a window pair and a small window upstairs, no loggia) and not this type

eaves.note: a cream eaves board 0.25 m deep at 6.0-6.3 m (De la Reijstraat 28-42 strip 2023), 0.4 m out, the red-tile roof face rising behind it; the roof lights in the tile face (two per house) are not drawn

door-right.note: the front door pair (green on Colensostraat, blue on Vaalrivierstraat, top lights) on the loggia axis against the party wall, beside the neighbour's pair under one flat grey canopy (2.95-3.3 m on Colensostraat 13-25)

roof.evidence: 3DBAG LoD2.2 over the rows: a long saddle along the street from the 5.8-6.6 m eaves to a ridge at 11.9-12.4 m, front slope about 55 deg; the strips show that steep tile face with roof lights rising from the eaves board. Drawn as the front attic at 55 deg capped by 3DBAG (the LoD2.2 roof itself left low gablets at the gutter of every pand on De la Reijstraat 25-39, 2026-11-01)

rhythm.bays: a window axis and, against one party wall, the loggia axis over the door pair
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: window + door pair | 1: window + half loggia
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the loggias and door pairs meet on every second party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: door pair under a shared flat canopy, one window
rhythm.roofline: a cream eaves board, a steep red-tile roof face with roof lights

the loggia of a pair is one opening across the party wall; drawn as two halves, each with a thin brick jamb at the party line
the door pair is drawn as one door
the roof lights in the tile face are not drawn
notes: Kit: FrontIntent.loggia (buildingRecipe/frontLoggia.ts, #158) is the recessed loggia on an ordinary front: the axis's window becomes an opening cut 1 m into the wall over a parapet, glazed at its back.
